title: The blank button
body: The annex at night. The elevator panel has eleven numbers and a warmth where a twelfth would be. A work order in your pocket is the only key the map does not have.

outcome.text: The car rises past 11 without slowing. The display says 11. The doors are thinking about it.

choices.label: Take the stairs back to the desk. Not tonight.

outcome.text: The work order is still in your pocket. The zone will wait. The system prefers that.
